name: morya
description: 1. Create a new Google Sheet. Open Extensions > Apps Script. 2. Paste `apps-script/Code.gs`. Change `TOKEN` to your own secret. 3. Run `doPost` once manually is not needed; instead: Deploy > New deployment > Web app,    Execute as **Me**, Access **Anyone**. Authorise Drive + Sheets when asked. Copy the `/exec` URL.    (After any code change, use Deploy > Manage deployments > Edit > New version.)
